metadata.question: Within a 100 km radius of (-1.593993, -49.053062) in the Amazon Rainforest, on August 19, 2009, is there a greater presence of cloud cover over land areas compared to river areas?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point(-49.053062, -1.593993) with 100 km radius buffer - Date: August 19, 2009 (single day, may need to expand if no data) - Collection: Landsat 5 or 7 for 2009 (Landsat 8 started 2013, Sentinel-2 started 2015) - Need cloud masking information, not to mask clouds but to identify where clouds are 2. Masking strategy: - DO NOT mask clouds - we want to measure cloud presence - Use QA bands or cloud probability to identify cloudy pixels - For Landsat 5/7: Use pixel_qa or sr_cloud_qa bands - Need to separate land vs river areas using water masks 3. Logic: - Use JRC Global Surface Water or other water dataset to identify rivers - Calculate cloud percentage over land areas - Calculate cloud percentage over river areas - Compare: if cloud_land > cloud_river → A, else → B - Handle C1: No images found - Handle C2: No valid pixels in AOI - Handle C3: Invalid calculations ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const center = ee.Geometry.Point([-49.053062, -1.593993]); const aoi = center.buffer(100000); // 100 km radius const startDate = '2009-08-19'; const endDate = '2009-08-20'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Try Landsat 5 first, then Landsat 7 let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); let collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 5 images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 7 images found: ${collectionSize}`); } // Try expanding date range if still no data if (collectionSize === 0) { collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate('2009-08-15', '2009-08-23'); collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 5 images (expanded dates): ${collectionSize}`); } if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No images found for the specified date and location."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Get image and cloud information const image = collection.first(); const qaband = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); // Bit 3 is cloud for Landsat Collection 2 const cloudMask = qaband.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).gt(0); // 4. Get water mask from JRC Global Surface Water const water = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater').select('occurrence'); const waterMask = water.gt(50); // Areas that are water >50% of the time const landMask = waterMask.not(); // 5. Calculate cloud coverage over land and water const cloudOverLand = cloudMask.updateMask(landMask); const cloudOverWater = cloudMask.updateMask(waterMask); // Count pixels const landCloudStats = cloudOverLand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: aoi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterCloudStats = cloudOverWater.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: aoi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const landCloudPixels = landCloudStats['QA_PIXEL_sum'] || 0; const landTotalPixels = landCloudStats['QA_PIXEL_count'] || 0; const waterCloudPixels = waterCloudStats['QA_PIXEL_sum'] || 0; const waterTotalPixels = waterCloudStats['QA_PIXEL_count'] || 0; console.log(`Land pixels: ${landTotalPixels}, Cloud over land: ${landCloudPixels}`); console.log(`Water pixels: ${waterTotalPixels}, Cloud over water: ${waterCloudPixels}`); // 6. Check for valid data if (landTotalPixels === 0 || waterTotalPixels === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels found for land or water areas."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 7. Calculate percentages const landCloudPercent = (landCloudPixels / landTotalPixels) * 100; const waterCloudPercent = (waterCloudPixels / waterTotalPixels) * 100; console.log(`Cloud cover over land: ${landCloudPercent.toFixed(2)}%`); console.log(`Cloud cover over rivers: ${waterCloudPercent.toFixed(2)}%`); // 8. Validation & Final Answer if (isNaN(landCloudPercent) || isNaN(waterCloudPercent)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (landCloudPercent > waterCloudPercent) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
